confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Costa del Sol resort pricing in July high season, not from live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel rates are less certain because July demand swings widely. FX provenance is weaker than the anchors: the 2026-10-15 4pm observation of 0.6955 came from search-result text attributed to the RBA and was not confirmed by opening the RBA page. A secondary OFX figure (about 1.4377 AUD per USD, which inverts to about 0.6956) is consistent with it. An earlier search returned an older cached RBA table (March 2026), so the most recent observation should be re-verified against the RBA F11 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Costa del Sol coastal resort towns (Torremolinos, Fuengirola, Estepona) and the city of Málaga, adjusted upward for Marbella's premium resort positioning and July high-season accommodation demand. Beer, coffee, and wine anchors follow typical southern Spanish restaurant pricing, with cocktails priced at roughly two to three times beer.
